Titre H2 · Acne, world's 8th biggest disease
Paragraphe · You're not alone. Acne is a serious skin
settings.text: You're not alone. Acne is a serious skin disease affecting 80% of young adults. 42.5% continue to suffer into their 20s and 30s. Not to alarm you, but acne can cause permanent scarring if left untreated. Together with decreased self-esteem, loneliness, depression and anxiety. Our formulas are developed over years to help you overcome acne.

settings.text:
When you get acne, your skin makes too much oil and your pores get clogged up with dirt and germs. Perfect for bacteria growth.
The result is the frustrating red bumps on your face.

settings.text:
To stop acne and smoothen your skin with new life two things need to happen.

1. Instant treatment

2. Long term prevention
Beeswax, Nettle and Thistle are very anti-inflammatory and will adjust the oil production and make your pores open and clean over time.
